# velin-stagger

Stagger child animations (delay in ms).

## Values
| Value | Meaning | Bridges to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ms number | Stagger delay between children | Motion runtime |
## Example

```html
<ul velin-stagger="80">…</ul>
```

## Accessibility

Stagger delays collapse under reduced motion.
